messages:
Maya (Support): Heads-up 0: this just came in from a customer (FinBank) via support. They need incremental structured frames delivered to their webhook while chat+fn_call streams. Each frame must be schema-validated and include a resumable cursor.
Sam (Product): Paste the ticket excerpt? Is this for chat fn_call streaming or the generic completions stream?
Maya (Support): Chat + fn_call. Excerpt: "We must ingest partial JSON frames, validate each against our schema, and be able to ack or request a retry. Missing frames must be resumable by seq id or cursor. Also need an explicit final event."
Ravi (Sales): We demoed yesterday; customer said this is blocking PoC. If we can't support it as a beta feature they may drop us. They care about per-frame authenticity (HMAC) and the ability to revert on validation errors.
Dev (Eng): Engineering perspective: runtime currently emits token deltas. To support frame-level structured events we'll need changes in framing layer + webhook delivery pipeline. Proposed primitives: event envelope with type, seq_id, optional schema_hash, resume_cursor; ERROR frame shape; FINAL frame.
Sam (Product): Draft acceptance criteria: (1) Streaming API emits event types: frame / error / final. (2) Each frame has seq_id and optional schema_id (sha256). (3) Resume using cursor/seq_id supported for webhook consumers. (4) SDK examples for HMAC verification. (5) Back-compat mode where clients can opt-in to receive consolidated final JSON.
Maya (Support): Customer requested behavior on validation failures: prefer an ERROR frame with path-level details and an action field (continue|abort). They want abort to be opt-in.
Dev (Eng): Agree default is send ERROR frame with {seq_id, errors: [...], action: "continue"}. If client sets ?abort_on_error=true, stream will close with final error event. Implementation unknowns: how resume interacts with KV cache and batching heuristics.
Ravi (Sales): Billing/metrics concern: If we surface frame counts in the console, accounting will be clearer. For pricing, recommend token billing unchanged; expose frame_count metric but avoid per-frame charges. Need legal sign-off for Beta commercial terms.
Sam (Product): Priority decision: this maps to regulated customers and integrations team. Recommendation: High priority, plan Beta for Dedicated/Private customers next quarter, GA after telemetry and perf validation.
Maya (Support): Can we offer a pilot to FinBank on Dedicated? They indicated they'd accept Beta in Dedicated.
Dev (Eng): Rough estimate: 2-week spike to prove resume + framing protos, then ~4w to harden (webhook ordering, retries, idempotency, tests, docs). Key risks: increased complexity in batching and potential latency regression.
Sam (Product): Action items: @Dev (Eng) run 2-week spike to produce a prototype envelope and resume tests; @Maya (Support) collect exact schema + acceptance tests from FinBank; @Ravi (Sales) confirm commercial/beta terms. Rollout gates: median per-frame latency under 250ms, successful resume flows, billing model clarified.
Dev (Eng): Prototype framing envelope I'm testing: 
```
{"type":"frame","seq_id":42,"schema_id":"sha256:abcd...","payload":{...}}
{"type":"error","seq_id":43,"errors":[{"path":"items[0].amount","msg":"invalid number"}],"action":"continue"}
{"type":"final","seq_id":99,"cursor":"c_eyJz..."}
```
Maya (Support): FinBank also asked for example SDK code to verify HMAC and to rehydrate partial payloads. I'll request sample vectors and an acceptance checklist.
Ravi (Sales): I'll flag the need for HMAC and resume guarantees to the AE and legal. If we promise these for Beta, we should document limitations.
Sam (Product): Decision: create epic "streamed-framed-outputs" with scope: Beta for Dedicated/Private, opt-in parameter streaming=framed, default legacy behavior unchanged. GA depends on telemetry and infra impact.
infra-bot: Created issue RW-17899: streamed-framed-outputs (epic).
Maya (Support): I'll attach ticket, schema, and FinBank acceptance criteria to the epic and coordinate pilot start.
Dev (Eng): Adding spike checklist to RW-17899: framing prototype, resume tests, idempotency, small-scale perf run. Will post findings at end of spike.
Sam (Product): We'll review spike results in roadmap sync next week and decide on final prioritization. Closing thread for now — follow-ups will happen in the epic comments. :thumbsup:
